Title: Budget Screen
Verdict: Cost fit yes, likely non-invasive yes, accuracy plausibly good (inherits [2]'s 98%) — but the size range this specific optical path can actually resolve is untested and needs a bench trial before trusting it.

Title: Two-Stage Screen + Confirm (standout recommendation)
P1: Dip/immersed probe [4] (stage 1) + discrete filtered/stained sample [1,3] (stage 2, on trigger)
P3: Discrete photodetector [4] (stage 1) + smartphone camera or USB microscope [1,3] (stage 2)
P6: Cloud dashboard/IoT [4], escalating to onboard touchscreen or app on trigger
Verdict: Cheapest average running cost (expensive stage runs rarely), solves the two biggest documented weaknesses in the literature set at once. Worth prototyping first.
